features.title: F1: Deployable skeleton
features.body:
Get a fresh clone to a running Next.js + Convex app deployed on HTTPS, with video upload/playback and a Claude call proven end to end. Every other card depends on this, and it de-risks the two unknowns (video upload from a phone, Claude from a Convex action) before feature work starts.

Children: US1-US4.
features.label: feature

stories.title: US1: Scaffold Next.js + Convex app
stories.body:
As a developer, I can clone the repo and run the whole app locally with one command.

Next.js App Router at the repo root, with Convex initialized per §1.1.1.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] `npm install && npm run dev` starts Next.js and Convex together
- [ ] `convex/schema.ts` exists (placeholder table is fine)
- [ ] The home page renders a value read from a Convex query, and it updates live when the row changes in the Convex dashboard
- [ ] `npm run build` and the type check pass
- [ ] README lists the setup steps for a fresh clone

stories.title: US2: Deploy to Vercel with Convex production
stories.body:
As a resident, I can open the app on my phone over HTTPS and grant camera access.

Phones only allow camera access on HTTPS sites (§1.1.1), so the demo needs a real deploy.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Pushing to `main` deploys to Vercel and the Convex production deployment (deploy key in Vercel env)
- [ ] The production URL loads on an iPhone and an Android phone
- [ ] A test page on the production URL shows a live rear-camera preview after the permission prompt

stories.title: US3: Upload a video to Convex storage and play it back
stories.body:
As a resident, I can upload a short video from my phone and watch it play back.

Uses Convex upload URLs (generate URL → POST file → save storage ID) per §1.1.1. The capture UI is §4.1.1 and not part of this card; a plain file input is fine here.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] A test page uploads a ~15s phone video through a Convex upload URL and saves the storage ID
- [ ] The video plays back on the phone from `ctx.storage.getUrl()`
- [ ] Upload time and file size for a 15s clip on cellular are recorded in the PR (the POST times out after 2 minutes)

stories.title: US4: Call Claude from a Convex action
stories.body:
As a developer, I can call Claude from the server without the API key reaching the browser.

Per §1.1.1, Claude is called only from Convex actions. Use the model and effort locked in §1.1.3 (`claude-opus-5-5`, effort `low`), read from env vars so they're easy to change. The full screening/categorizing prompt belongs to later cards (§1.1.3, §4.2.1).

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and the model name are set as Convex environment variables (dev and prod)
- [ ] A Convex action sends a prompt plus one image and returns Claude's reply to a test page
- [ ] The key doesn't appear in the client bundle (search the build output)
